name: Ongwe Minerals Inc.
summary: Ongwe Minerals Inc. is a Vancouver-based gold exploration company seeking gold systems in Namibia and Egypt, and also exploring for lithium and phosphate. Its flagship projects are Khorixas at 1,690 square kilometers, Omatjete at 1,440 square kilometers and Outjo at 460 square kilometers, all within the Damara Orogenic Belt.
